scriptcustomfield.description: PC | Internal id of the Support value in the engagement type list, created in the UI.
scriptcustomfield.help: Internal id of the Support value of the engagement type list. Until it is set, Support deals are reported as unmapped.
scriptcustomfield.label: PC | Support Type ID

scriptcustomfield.description: PC | Test only. Throws a fault after this step of createEndClient or createProject, for ZZ TEST records only.
scriptcustomfield.help: Test only. Leave blank in normal use. Honored only for records whose name or title starts with ZZ TEST.
scriptcustomfield.label: PC | Fail After Step (Test)

scriptcustomfield.description: PC | Script id or internal id of the saved search behind the travel project list.
scriptcustomfield.help: Leave blank to use customsearch901 (Navan Project Export). The search must have columns labeled Name and Email.
scriptcustomfield.label: PC | Travel Search ID

scriptcustomfield.description: PC | Internal id of the subsidiary new end clients belong to (OneWorld). Power Cloud Consulting, LLC is 1.
scriptcustomfield.help: Set on the sales deployment. Every end client the sales process creates belongs to this subsidiary; blank leaves the account default, which fails on a OneWorld account.
scriptcustomfield.label: PC | End Client Subsidiary ID

scriptcustomfield.description: PC | Comma-separated action names that the API refuses. The kill switch.
scriptcustomfield.help: Comma-separated action names, for example createProject,closeOpportunity. A listed action returns PC_API_DISABLED before any record is touched. Leave blank for normal use.
scriptcustomfield.label: PC | Disabled Actions
